text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, an extracurricular activity was scheduled to be held at Chairwoman Akikawa's private beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of it all, though, we were hit by a sudden storm
while out on a long-distance swim training session—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, what is this situation?!
Getting washed up on a deserted island is just impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...So what if we're unhurt?
It doesn't change the fact that this situation is the absolute worst...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to an unexpected accident,
Narita Taishin seems to be overwhelmed by anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the terminal still had signal, so I was able to contact Chairwoman Akikawa to send a rescue team.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. If I knew this would happen,
I would've been way better off training at the academy."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If that were the case, I never would've
been washed up in a place like this...
choice_data_list: Extracurricular study has a real purpose, you know.
Extracurricular study has a real purpose, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I went on to explain that tackling different training than usual would allow her to adapt and run in various situations—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Then doesn't that mean I'm falling
further and further behind the others?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Now I'm getting even more pissed off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin couldn't hide her frustration.
I wanted to find a way to ease her burden, but...
choice_data_list: There's training we can do even here!
Let's do our best so they can find us quickly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I suggested that training while waiting for help
would keep any delays to a minimum—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Alright.
Just say the word, and I'll tackle them one by one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps out of impatience, she nods obediently for once.
Watching her from the corner of my eye, I put together her training menu.
First off――

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh... There are too many sticks and stones
mixed into the sand getting in my way!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(If this were a race,
just how rough of a track is this...?!)
choice_data_list: Look far ahead and find the optimal route!
Look ahead and find the optimal route!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like I...
need you to tell me that...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running along the untouched beach had plenty of obstacles,
which seemed to train leg strength and judgment even better
than ordinary beach running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Kh! Catching fish with our bare hands...
Is this really supposed to be training!?
choice_data_list: This will build your dynamic vision and agility!
This will build your dynamic vision and agility!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Really? If you're lying just to get food,
I'll wring your neck later... got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez...!
Every single one of you, darting around all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be,
I'll catch every single fish around here...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? I-I caught it!?
Trainer, what do I do with this!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's so fast and slimy...
Do something about it already!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's one down!
Next time, I'm catching an even bigger one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …………What are you smirking at?
choice_data_list: I'm just glad to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? What are you talking about, dummy?
It's not like I'm playing around...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean, don't just stand there watching—help me catch it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You can at least collect shells from the sand
or dive into the sea to gather sea urchins, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, until help arrived,
we devoted ourselves to training using the natural environment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps thanks to the special training,
Narita Taishin seemed to have grown
significantly by the time she headed home."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I suggested writing SOS in the sand
to make it even slightly easier for someone to spot us."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I've got no choice.
I get restless if I'm not doing something anyway."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us searched the area
and found a large branch,
so we decided to use it to write a message.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Big and deep so it's easy to spotâ
We split into roles: one watching from afar to give directions, and the other writing the message.
choice_data_list: The next character is three steps to the right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Hup, to it...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... Writing out all these letters is surprisingly tough.
In a way, maybe it counts as training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I-It's done...!
An SOS message...!
choice_data_list: Good work. Here, have some coconut juice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why would there be juice on a deserted island... wait,
it's just the raw fruit itself?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*Pfft*. Drinking straight from the fruit... I've only ever seen that in video games.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Still, the taste is surprisingly not bad...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Phew,
I don't wanna move for a while.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …………Hey, um.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Writing a message is fine and all, but what if it doesn't get found...?
choice_data_list: You two worked so hard making it, so it'll definitely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so.
Well, I figured you'd say that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Asking a question when I already knew the answer, just to reassure myself... God, I'm such an idiot.)
Heeey... Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Is that... a rescue team!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Wake up already, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, isn't it a bit too carefree
to be fast asleep in a situation like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The rescue team... Um...
They said they saw our 'SOS' sign and came for us.

text_block_list.name: Rescue Worker
text_block_list.text:
"That really helped us out!
Thanks to that, we were able to find it much sooner than expected!"
choice_data_list: I see... See, what did I tell you?
I see... See, didn't I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though we went through a rough time with unexpected trouble,
I feel like today brought me
a little closer to Narita Taishin.
